extensions.name: Avalara AvaTax
extensions.description: Real-time sales tax from Avalara AvaTax

images.title: Connect your AvaTax account
images.description: Enter the account ID, license key and company code from AvaTax, then turn AvaTax on in Settings → Taxes.

images.title: Sales tax at checkout
images.description: Taxes come from AvaTax for every cart and order, and paid orders are recorded in AvaTax for filing.

images.title: Tax-exempt customers
images.description: Set an entity use code and exemption number on the customer; AvaTax exempts their orders where it applies.

images.title: Check the connection
images.description: Test connection checks the credentials and the company before you turn AvaTax on.
